links.title: Telegram links to validate
links.description: Any mix of https://t.me/name, t.me/name, https://t.me/s/name, @name or bare name. Invite links (t.me/+hash, t.me/joinchat/...) are reported as private-invite because they cannot be checked without joining.

includeDemoSample.title: Include the free demo sample of 35 chats
includeDemoSample.description: Adds 35 real Russian-speaking B2B chats (WB/Ozon sellers, wholesale, cargo, IT) to the dataset. This is the free slice of the 1,000+ chat base.

demoTopics.title: Filter the demo sample by category
demoTopics.description: Leave empty for all categories. Example: ["Маркетплейсы WB/Ozon", "Закупки/Опт"].

minMembers.title: Minimum members/subscribers
minMembers.description: Drop chats below this size from the demo sample. 0 keeps everything.

includeOffer.title: Include the full-base offer record
includeOffer.description: Adds one summary record with the direct purchase link for the full 1,000+ chat base (TW1-TG), the RUB price and the Plati.Market card.

concurrency.title: Parallel requests
concurrency.description: How many t.me pages to fetch at once. Keep it at 3 or lower: Telegram rate-limits aggressive scrapers.
